body:
Review findings addressed in 4276e97e8 (plain push on top of 8460431c7):

1. **G40 before positioning.** `G40` now rides the section's first motion, `G40 G00 X Y` to the threading point, instead of the first cut. Source: the cited Sodick manual shows `G40` on a move (`G40 Y-.02`); RS-274 / ISO 6983 put `G40` in its own modal group, so it may share the block with `G00`, and cancelling with no offset active is legal. So the placement change was made, not a header-only warning. The arc-as-first-cut refusal stays (its reason reworded: an arc start from the threading point is not shown in the source).
2. **Condition table.** Header line `(EACH C CONDITION NAMED BELOW MUST EXIST IN THE CONTROL CONDITION TABLE BEFORE START)`, and per section `(CONDITION C110 MUST EXIST IN THE CONTROL CONDITION TABLE - CHECK ITS VALUES)` before its first motion, built from the operation's condition id.
3. **Closing keyword.** New commit body ends `Refs #617`; the PR body now ends `Refs #617` with no closing keyword and notes that the first commit's message still carries one, so the merger must check issue 617 stays open (reopen it if GitHub closes it).

The Sodick golden `wire_slug_punch.nc` regenerated with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` (diff: the two condition lines, `G40` moved from the G01 to the G00); the recorded refusal goldens are unchanged. Decision record and `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` updated.

Tests (`-j 4`, on the new head): `camcraft-post --test script_sodick_wire` 11 passed; `camcraft-app --test sodick_wire_post` 8, `--test wire_post` 8, `--test conformance` 7 passed; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

Effort: effort:max

Merging now under the maintainer's standing answer of 2026-11-13 (question dialog: "Yes, standing rule" - reviewed merge-ready feat PRs merge at once; the cut comes later). Not exercised: no Sodick control or simulator ran the output; no multi-section test. Issue 617 stays open: this is a first slice, and the unconfirmed points in the PR body are still owed.
